run_download_s2ef_data: run the download_data script to download and preprocess S2EF training data for a specified split like 200k or all
run_download_is2re_data: run the download_data script to download and extract IS2RE train val test LMDB data
run_download_s2ef_test: run the download_data script to download and move S2EF test data into the s2ef all directory
run_download_with_cleanup: run the download_data script with intermediate file cleanup enabled to save disk space after processing
run_download_with_custom_path: run the download_data script with a custom data path to save datasets to a specific directory
